command: After the 16-GiB admission guard passes, use scripts/run_memory_capped.sh with -j2 and its 10G/14G user-cgroup limits to rebuild the exact Garnet transcript. Preserve the observed first divergence (block 0, word 0, 0x10000 reads zero) while diagnosing the missing upstream runtime behavior.
success_condition: The actual Garnet top accepts the post-PCFG input transcript, finishes the official stream sequence, and every output byte matches the upstream Gaussian golden without a timeout, protocol error, or dropped packet.
failure_policy: Preserve the verified PCFG transcript. Locate the first divergent output block, control interrupt, or proc-packet transaction; do not bypass Garnet with nested Interconnect ports or alter official packet/AXI values. Do not start a heavy task below 16 GiB available memory; keep it at -j2 inside the user memory cgroup.
